Review of cycle_count_variance (request_changes): Found a bug in all_positions: you only add a system position when its location appears in counted_locations. But a position with system stock at a location that was never counted still has a non-zero variance (0 counted - system qty) and should be reported. Add every (sku, loc) from system_stock unconditionally, not just those whose location was counted. The rest (normalization, dedup, sorting, negative-qty guard) looks correct.
